justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: 35-40% fall reduction replicated across 5 RCTs and validated meta-analyses. Mortality benefit in 80+ demonstrated.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 2-3 day in-person training; moderate cost ~$300-500; widely available through PT schools.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to any clinician treating older adults; broad in geriatric PT/OT but limited in pediatric or acute care.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Standard PT billing; Otago documentation supports fall prevention medical necessity across Medicare and commercial payers.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Growing employer demand in skilled nursing, home health, and geriatric outpatient; increasingly listed in fall prevention roles.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Acceptable to older adults but motivation to sustain exercise without accountability can wane; lower than group-based programs.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Some adult-children-of-aging-parents will pay for fall prevention, but most demand routes through Medicare home health/outpatient.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Generic evidence-based protocol with no proprietary moat; doesn't command premium rates.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Common in geriatric circles; widely available and not particularly defensible.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Highly protocol-based and staff-deliverable — good leverage for a falls-prevention program model.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumers ask for 'balance training,' not Otago by name.
justifications.business.efficiency: Free/low-cost online training; very high efficiency.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Known and respected in geriatric academic circles but not a CV centerpiece.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Robust implementation science and effectiveness literature.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Excellent teaching exemplar for evidence-based falls prevention in geriatric coursework.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Multiple RCTs and Cochrane-level support for falls reduction.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Rarely listed as required/preferred in postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Free, fast — strong ROI for academic CV padding in geriatrics.
